attributes.action: Change to the crimes against persons BIGAMY law  . To include all in the UK .
attributes.additional_details: UK Bigamy laws favour foreigners who want to gain access  to UK for citizenship and funds for their foreign families by deception and misrepresentation of intent ( grooming).  thousands of British nationals are abused via this law as it stands .BIGAMY MUST A CRIME FOR ALL LAW MUST SHOW NO PARTIALITY NO FAVOUR.  The law as it stands gives polygamous  foreigners unfair advantage . This BIGAMY LAW MUST BE FOR ALL WHO LIVE UNDER UK LAW .
attributes.background: Amend Bigamy laws to include  all UK citizens and residents to close the loop hole which is cause abuse for visas and spousal visa victimizing those who marry foreign nationals who then marry foreign wives unknown to the citizen it is subject to abuse by foreigners with polygamous  customs .

rejection.details: We do not know exactly what you want. Our bigamy laws mean that you cannot marry twice (while retaining the first wife) in this country. Other countries have different rules and we are not clear what you are proposing in respect of such people if they were to come to the UK.
